name: Friendship and Beyond at Disneyland Resort (Toy Story / Pixar Pier)
description: Fuselage: Whole fuselage, belly and fin sky blue with white clouds (Andy's-room wallpaper style). Cheatlines: None. Tail: Sky-blue fin with Toy Story characters (Jessie, Woody) painted on it. Engines: Sky-blue cowlings. Winglets: Sky blue. Titles: White 'Alaska' script forward; 'Follow us to Disneyland' in white near the nose. Artwork: Oversized Woody, Buzz Lightyear and Jessie and other Pixar characters on the aft fuselage; the nose cone painted as the Pixar ball (yellow with a red star and blue stripe). Colors hex: approximate.

logos.description: The nose cone painted as the Pixar Luxo ball: yellow with a red star on the front and a blue band round it.
'Disneyland Resort' script logo in white below 'Follow us to', between the cockpit and the forward door.

The Pixar Pier sign aft of the wing: a cream arched board with 'PIXAR PIER' in red slab capitals and a Pixar ball under it, flanked by red-and-white onion-domed towers (the larger one aft, about x 0.72-0.77, floor to crown).
Woody, huge, flying forward with both arms out (yellow checked shirt, cow-print vest, brown hat), filling the aft fuselage from the belly to the crown between about x 0.76 and 0.93.
Buzz Lightyear (white, green and purple) behind and above Woody, where the fin meets the fuselage.
Jessie twirling a lasso with her red hat held high near the tip, riding Bullseye (black and white) below her, on white clouds; the lasso's rope loops back over the fin.

titles.style: The 2016 Alaska wordmark in white, big, across the forward windows.
Small white sans, above the Disneyland logo.

notes: Drawn from the right side (2025-06-07, side-on) and checked on the left (2024-08-05): the same layout on both sides. Small white cartoon clouds are scattered over the blue (a big one round the cockpit; not drawn). The belly's bottom looks lighter gray in the side-on photo, which may be paint or light; not drawn. Registration in white over the windows: on the right ahead of the Pixar Pier sign, on the left aft of the wing. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on the June 2025 right-side photo (side-on; the forward door as the scale, about 40 px/m): 'Alaska' runs from just behind the door (5.4 m) to over the wing root (14.5 m), x 0.143-0.38, longer than first drawn (0.18); 'Follow us to' runs 2.75-4.4 m back (x 0.072-0.115) above the Disneyland logo. Lowercase heights recorded. Drawn on the 737-800; the fuselage is one colour, nothing to smooth.
